currentSourceHardening.sourceStatus: Final working tree has the order-ID-only model Undo tool and app-owned failure acknowledgement. The source fingerprint matches the independently reviewed three-case order-resolved run; the broader 26-case release and six-case holdout remain evidence from earlier source.
currentSourceHardening.progressSemantics: resolved=true means a reviewed action was accepted for the order; it does not establish that follow-up is complete. A carrier order may remain Review and a duplicate hold may remain Waiting. completed=true means released to packing, not physically packed or shipped. Ready alone proves neither acceptance nor release.
currentSourceHardening.orderDetails: The latest receipt exposes proposal kind and total change count to the trusted selector. The app-owned answer names recorded status, issue, evidence, saved value, release state, latest receipt, and whole-receipt size.
currentSourceHardening.selectorEvidence: Jev receives trusted latest receipt kind and change count. It can route “Undo just this order” to a subset refusal for a multi-change receipt, and recognized earlier-correction requests with a later batch to a maintained no-preview reply. Runtime rechecks that the latest receipt is a batch before using that reply. This known-case route is not a general intent guarantee.
currentSourceHardening.undoGuard: The model tool accepts only orderId, expectedKind, and expectedChanges. Repository prepareUndo resolves the latest whole receipt and checks expected kind/count plus existing version/staleness rules inside the transaction before storing a proposal. These checks do not prove user intent. The human Undo flow remains unchanged.
currentSourceHardening.tutorialScope: During an active tutorial, a packing-subset reply explains that preparation is limited to its assigned practice group and tells the person to finish or dismiss that tutorial before requesting the full Work queue.
currentSourceHardening.tutorialRegression: The older verified18 run had one partial because the final answer misstated the tutorial’s first instruction. The latest implementation returns the current recorded instruction; the post-review current-source rerun is checking this behavior.
currentSourceHardening.tutorialAcknowledgement: After a successful tutorial start or stop, the coordinator reads current tutorial state and returns the recorded title and instruction. It does not claim that a target was displayed.
currentSourceHardening.receiptKindVocabulary: getOrder exposes latestReceipt.kind using the proposal-kind values expected by prepareUndo and omits raw receipt IDs from the model tool result. Acceptance kind remains a distinct internal fact.
currentSourceHardening.failedPreparationAcknowledgement: After an unrecovered preparation error, if the model ends without a successfully presented review, the runtime emits an app-owned failure acknowledgement. A valid retry followed by a displayed proposal receives the regular acknowledgement.
currentSourceHardening.validationStatus: All 54 Browser Mode tests passed, including desktop and narrow layouts, before the final server-only Undo changes. All 22 E2E tests passed on the final source; build, typecheck, and guidance boundary check also passed. The 240-test full server run passed 239 tests and failed one existing 1-second wall-clock assertion at 1266 ms. An isolated provider-audit rerun passed all 18 tests, including that assertion at 749 ms. Thus all 240 unique server tests passed across the full run and isolated rerun. The targeted final-source Undo regression passed 3/3.
